what_happened: Main CI failed the stale/future token test with Missing expected rejection; the test captured a second and later let the verifier read a new clock. The exact failing loop item was not logged.
expected: Each negative boundary assertion should build and verify its token against one fixed instant.

root_cause.text: A deterministic replay shows iat=sec+31 rejects at sec but legitimately passes at sec+1 (30-second skew). This demonstrates a test timing race; the specific failing parameter in the historical run is unverified.

rule: Use one injected clock for token fixtures and verifier boundary assertions, and test the exact allowed and rejected sides explicitly.
